text_block_list.text:
—The 3rd UGE. At Tokyo Racecourse,
ST-2 and Symboli Kris S
were warming up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're late.
Everyone's already gathered.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Ain't half bad. Compared to the beginning,
my running's improved a ton.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's all it is. Right now, you're nothing more
than a robot with a bit of personality.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: "Thanks for doing the tandem run with me, Kris S. That really helped."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Also, before the examination...
If there is anything else I can assist with—

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: N-No, I don't think I can drink it like this.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it seems I can deliver a good run today.
Let us begin the real thing.
